typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Open_Date as string,
		Tri_Party_Deal_Acct as string,
		Trader as string,
		Customer as string,
		Deal_Date as string,
		Daily_Interest as integer,
		{Eg_New Deals} as string,
		Deal_rate as double,
		Deal_type as string,
		To_Date_Interest as integer,
		Deal_Num as double,
		Return_type as string,
		Process_Date as timestamp,
		Client as string,
		Principal as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Open_Date as string,
		Tri_Party_Deal_Acct as string,
		Trader as string,
		Customer as string,
		Deal_Date as string,
		Daily_Interest as integer,
		Eg_New_Deals as string,
		Deal_rate as double,
		Deal_type as string,
		To_Date_Interest as integer,
		Deal_Num as double,
		Return_type as string,
		Process_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Client as string,
		Principal as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Open_Date,
		Tri_Party_Deal_Acct,
		Trader,
		Customer,
		Deal_Date,
		Daily_Interest,
		Eg_New_Deals = {Eg_New Deals},
		Deal_rate,
		Deal_type,
		To_Date_Interest,
		Deal_Num,
		Return_type,
		Process_Date,
		Client,
		Principal),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
